title: [Shortcut Guide] Restore keyboard tab order and accessible focus to shortcut items

proposed_comments.title: Group shortcut collection Tab navigation
proposed_comments.body:
### Group shortcut Tab navigation

**Severity:** `medium`

The `ScrollViewer` is now excluded from the Tab sequence, but the contained `MainItemsRepeater` has no `TabFocusNavigation` setting and each `ShortcutItemView` is a Tab stop. That can make keyboard users traverse shortcut cards one-by-one rather than treating the repeater as a single Tab stop. Set `TabFocusNavigation="Once"` on `MainItemsRepeater` so Tab enters and leaves the collection as a group while arrow-key navigation remains available; please verify both behaviors at runtime.

confidence.rationale: Pinned upstream XAML leaves the repeater ungrouped while its shortcut rows are Tab stops; the one-attribute candidate is localized and builds, but the claimed navigation behavior still needs interactive runtime verification.
